name: admin-proposals-settings
title: admin-proposals-settings
description: admin-proposals's section of the Settings dialog: The dashboard's side of the agent's changes to itself: the proposals that `proposals` holds (proposals-local on a server, proposals-github on Cloudflare) listed with their diff and checks, approved or rejected there by an operator; and a Settings section saying whether they can be made and approved now, with the deploys that follow. Its settings come with the component (pikit add admin-proposals), stored by settings-store.
